blocks.content:
In this milestone, you add the ClickHouse data source in Grafana Cloud and give it a descriptive name. Adding a data source requires the Grafana organization administrator role.

To add the data source, complete the following steps.
In the navigation menu, click **Connections > Data sources**.

In the **Name** field, enter a descriptive name for this data source.

For example, enter `ClickHouse observability`. The name appears on dashboard panels, so choose something meaningful.

You now have a ClickHouse data source ready to configure.

In the next milestone, you'll enter the connection details and credentials for your ClickHouse server.
